answer_1.quote: Question generation aims to automatically generate questions from textual inputs.

answer_2.quote: Following previous works, we employ BLEU 1-4 , METEOR , and ROUGE-L  as automated evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation on 300 random test samples... We ask three workers to rate the 300 generated questions as well as the ground-truth questions between 1 (poor) and 5 (good) on three criteria
answer_4.guideline: raters evaluate the generation quality from three important aspects of deep questions: fluency, relevance, and complexity
